value.rationale: The question is intrinsically motivated by the newly introduced avalanche homology and the primary paper’s explicit interest in graph operations. The disjoint union has a single synchronized global time parameter, so it is not determined by the individual avalanche complexes: varying gcd changes its sphere dimension even for fixed total vertex count. The result classifies an infinite two-parameter family integrally with a clean arithmetic synchronization law, offering a test case for graph-operation and multi-cycle extensions; it is not an arbitrary finite slice.
